SASBDB entry SASDRJ8  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDRJ8/)

Publication: Kurihara K, Umezawa K, Donnelly AE, Sperling B, Liao G, Hecht MH, Arai R,
Crystal structure and activity of a de novo enzyme, ferric enterobactin esterase Syn-F4,
Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A (2023). DOI: https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2218281120

Files (all downloaded from https://www.sasbdb.org/media/, unmodified):
  experimental_data/SASDRJ8.dat   the curve (q in nm^-1, I, sigma); the depositor notes
                                  "Experimental errors are severely overestimated"
  SASDRJ8_fit2_model1.pdb         the atomic model of fit2 (PDB 8H7D, crystal structure,
                                  chains A and B, heavy atoms only, no waters)
  SASDRJ8_fit2.fit                the depositor's CRYSOL fit (q in 1/A; columns q, I, sigma,
                                  I_fit; chi^2 0.060, Dro 0.025, Ra 1.800)
fit1 (a DAMMIN dummy-atom model) is not bundled: it has no atomic coordinates.
